sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Hoeft State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (same on 2027-05-18, 06-15 and 09-21): 20/30-amp sites $34 (98 sites), 50-amp sites $39 (27); one site (#2) with 20/30/50 A and sewer $49. The DNR's 2026 table: modern $32 (20/30 A) / $37 (50 A), semi-modern $27 / $32 while the toilet/shower building is closed (outside May 15 - Oct 14); the booking site charged $27 / $32 on 2026-10-27. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($34 for the 20/30-amp sites, $39 for the 50-amp sites, $49 for site 2 on 2027-05-18 / 2027-06-15 / 2027-09-21; $27 / $32 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Hoeft Campground: $37 / $32 modern, $32 / $27 semi-modern; shower building May 15 to Oct. 14) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoeft ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoeft ('All sites have either 20- or 30-amp service, and a few sites have 20-, 30- and 50-amp service') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (27 sites with 50 A; 125 of 126 sites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; site 2 alone 'Sewer Hookup=Yes'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 126 sites in the modern campground's east and west loops, most generous in size and shaded by oaks, maples, hemlocks and pines; equipment lists run to 'Trailer or RV up to 50''. Every site but one is electric only; site 2 alone lists a sewer hookup.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoeft ('Number of sites: 126'; 'divided into two loops, the east and west loops'; amenities 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com allowed equipment and site attributes, read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoeft (Hoeft Modern Campground amenities 'Concession or store', 'Modern campground', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building') + the DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoeft ('Hoeft Modern Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online', linking https://www.midnrreservations.com/), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site: 126 sites in two loops, 20/30 A everywhere and 50 A at 27, electric only (one site, #2, has sewer), equipment to 50 ft, pull-throughs, shower building, sanitation station, store, reservable online or by phone; phone 989-734-2543 and michigan.gov link match. Fees 27-37 (2026 DNR table incl. semi-modern) -> 34-39 (2027 booking site; 2026 and the $49 sewer site in the note), Recreation Passport in fees.note. Season May 1 - Oct 31 already manual. Water/sewer not written (one site differs). --AWH note kept unchanged.
